rules.statement: Property acquired before marriage, such as money saved out of earnings, belongs to the husband or wife for their separate estate and is not considered part of the diathetam even if invested during marriage.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think, therefore, that the money which the husband had saved out of his earnings before his marriage belonged to him for his separate estate, whether it is strictly called mudusom or not. The circumstance that it was invested during marriage does not change its character."
